title: Console core miniscope: cost breakdown + trace sampling strategy
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Context: We need to ship a conservative, production-friendly subset of Console observability that delivers useful cost breakdowns and basic trace visibility while meeting budget and time constraints for the Q1 launch. This ticket captures the PRD clarifications, explicit scope cuts, acceptance criteria, and rollout constraints for the miniscope launch.
requirements_clarifications: 1) Cost breakdown: surface per-route token cost and 7-day delta. No per-user attribution in MVP; aggregate only. 2) Tracing: show top-5 slow routes with heatmap of p50/p95 latency; no distributed span visualization in MVP. 3) Sampling: default backend trace sampling = 1% globally; UI should allow tenant opt-in to 5% or 10% where supported. 4) Retention: raw traces retained for 7 days in MVP, aggregated metrics for 30 days. 5) Rollouts: staged feature flag rollout (5% -> 50% -> 100%) with manual abort. 6) Export: CSV export of cost table only; no dashboard embedding or widgets until Phase 2.
scope_cuts:
- Remove user-level cost attribution and billing export (defer to Phase 2).
- Simplify dashboards to one consolidated 'Cost & Latency' card per route instead of multiple tiles.
- Remove flamegraph/span-level drilldowns; provide a link to raw trace logs for engineering only.
- Defer historical compare beyond 7 days to avoid backend storage changes.
- Skip per-model quantization recommendations in the cost view.
- Postpone RBAC rules fine-grain controls; use coarse roles (admin/viewer) from SSO initial integration.
tradeoffs_and_rationale:
- Removing per-user attribution reduces storage and privacy risk and accelerates delivery.
- Limiting tracing detail reduces sampling and retention costs while preserving actionable latency signals.
- CSV-only export keeps scope small but provides immediate operational use.
- These cuts increase the likelihood of hitting roadmap dates at the expense of finer-grained debugging for early customers.
acceptance_criteria: Cost card shows route, total tokens, token cost (USD) for selected interval and 7-day delta.
Top-5 slow routes list displays p50 and p95 with sample counts and a single-line sparkline for trend.
Trace sampling default set to 1%; tenant-level opt-in toggles available in UI that switch sampling to 5% or 10% where backend supports it.
Raw traces are retrievable for 7-day window via a limited engineering-only link; UI surfaces link when a route is selected.
CSV export on the cost table exports the current filter set and date range, with numeric columns formatted and header row included.
End-to-end E2E smoke test demonstrates card renders within SLA: 95% of requests for dashboard load complete within 800ms in staging under synthetic load.
Feature flag gating implemented and manual rollback documented in runbook; rollout can be aborted immediately by ops with a single click.
Docs/PRD link present and product acceptance sign-off from EM and two PM stakeholders recorded.
